content: Root cause: The bug was caused by changes made to the `dump.c` file in a previous commit, which altered the way method tables were serialized. Specifically, the serialization function was incorrectly using method table structures instead of the appropriate type name structures, leading to issues when handling keyword arguments and method definitions. This resulted in incorrect serialization behavior, particularly when dealing with method caches and type definitions, which was not properly aligned with the expected data structures in the incremental serializer.
